composition.serve_who: Sheet 5 of 12 is the Danfoss PVG 32 mast manifold: its six titled function slices serve the lifting keel (up/down and locks) and four individually named mast winches, while the common inlet, P/T/load-sense rails, spool-control-pressure supply, and end section serve the mast-block manifold itself. This assignment follows the sheet title “MAST BLOCK: DANFOSS PVG 32 – 6 FUNCTIONS,” the six EV-6.x headings, and each slice’s printed A/B command mapping.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Both EV-6.1 “LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN” and EV-6.2 “LIFTING KEEL LOCKS” explicitly name functions of the lifting keel, so both attach to the established lifting-keel node rather than to the manifold node.

functions.label: Raise and lower the lifting keel
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally directs hydraulic oil to lower or raise the lifting keel, with A assigned to DOWN and B assigned to UP.

flow_scenarios.path: Manifold P supply → EV-6.1 open-neutral PVG spool → manifold T return; the A and B hoses remain associated only with the lifting-keel actuator, and the section load signal relaxes through the drawn load-sense network.

Manifold P supply → EV-6.1 proportional spool → work port A → lifting-keel DOWN side; oil from the opposite actuator side → work port B → spool → T return. The A-side load signal passes through the drawn shuttle/LS limiter network; its printed limiter setting is not reliably readable.

Manifold P supply → EV-6.1 proportional spool → work port B → lifting-keel UP side; oil from the opposite actuator side → work port A → spool → T return. The B-side load signal passes through the drawn shuttle/LS limiter network; its printed limiter setting is not reliably readable.

key_components: Proportional PVEU pilot module directing the main spool (assembly 11166832)
40 l/min main directional spool
A/B load-sense selector/shuttle network
Adjustable load-sense pressure limiters on the two work-port sensing branches
functions.dry_data: Danfoss PVG 32 module; 40 l/min spool; proportional PVEU 0–10 V; DOWN <5 V=A, UP >5 V=B; open neutral; established cartridges include 11166832 and 15785111.
functions.sheet_region: Leftmost function slice, EV-6.1, approximately x=20–31% of the schematic body.

functions.label: Insert and withdraw the lifting-keel locks
functions.what_it_does: Operates the lifting-keel locking actuators, sending oil to insert the locks on A or withdraw them on B.

flow_scenarios.path: EV-6.2 PVEO de-energized → closed-neutral spool blocks P from A/B and blocks actuator return through the spool, hydraulically holding the lock circuit.

Manifold P supply → section pressure-control/compensating stage → EV-6.2 shifted spool → work port A → lifting-keel lock IN side; opposite side → work port B → spool → T return. If A-side pressure reaches 180 bar, the A work-port relief opens → T return.

Manifold P supply → section pressure-control/compensating stage → EV-6.2 shifted spool → work port B → lifting-keel lock OUT side; opposite side → work port A → spool → T return. If B-side pressure reaches 180 bar, the B work-port relief opens → T return.

5 l/min closed-neutral directional spool

Work-port pressure selector/shuttle and load-sense path

functions.what_it_does: Directs oil to the aft-port mast winch’s hydraulic gear-selection actuator: A selects 1st/3rd gear and B selects 2nd gear.

flow_scenarios.path: PVEO de-energized → EV-6.3 spool in open neutral → manifold P gallery unloaded toward T; no commanded gear-selection pressure is applied to A or B.

Manifold P supply → EV-6.3 spool → work port A → aft-port mast-winch 1st/3rd-gear actuator side; opposite side → B → spool → T return. If A pressure reaches 250 bar, the A-side work-port relief opens → T return.

Manifold P supply → EV-6.3 spool → work port B → aft-port mast-winch 2nd-gear actuator side; opposite side → A → spool → T return. If B pressure reaches 230 bar, the B-side work-port relief opens → T return.

infrastructure.system_name: Danfoss PVG 32 mast block common hydraulic infrastructure
facts: Six-section mast manifold comprising EV-6.1 through EV-6.6, with a common inlet at far left and end section at far right.

Common drawn galleries/rails are P pressure supply, T tank return, LS load-sense, and sectional LS_A/LS_B signal rails; work ports A/B leave only their own named function slice for that function’s actuator.
The inlet section contains the main block pressure-relief valve set to 300 bar, discharging from the pressure passage to T.
The standalone reduced-pressure valve in the inlet section supplies spool-control/pilot pressure to the slice pilot modules.
An M measuring/test connection is drawn on the inlet/control passage.
Load-sense shuttles/selectors and section compensating/control elements communicate active load demand into the common LS structure.
The right-hand end section terminates the common manifold galleries; it is not an additional equipment function.

discarded_as_clutter: Duplicate legend/table restatements of each slice’s rating, actuation, command mapping, and neutral state after those facts were composed into the functions
Drawing title-block administration, company/contact/copyright text, scale, job number, sheet number, drafter/checker, and record dates
Revision-table rows 0–9 as document history unrelated to the six operational paths
Red warning triangles marked 8: revision markers for revision 8 “PRESSURE AFTER COMMISSIONING,” not hydraulic components
Repeated fine-print cartridge identifiers where they do not add an operational role

Prior-extraction pseudo-slices “Block inlet/end pressure and load-sense control section” and “Block end section” treated as equipment functions; these are manifold infrastructure, not extra served equipment
uncertainties: EV-6.1 has two printed load-sense limiter values, but the exact digits cannot be read cleanly enough from this sheet image; no values are asserted.
EV-6.4 clearly shows 250 bar and 225 bar work-port relief settings, but the line walk at this resolution does not securely assign which value belongs to external port A versus port B.
Some fine-print cartridge/spool part numbers are too small to capture; their identified operational roles are retained, and part numbers can be captured at inspection if ever needed.

Revision 10 is titled “PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES,” yet the visible EV-6.3 and EV-6.5 legends read PVEO ON/OFF; no proportional command characteristic is inferred without a drawn/printed slice-level mapping.
